parts.title: InferenceTask · work.json
parts.body: The top of the work file the run manager writes: the task's ID, where to write outputs, which output versions are current, and the work itself.

parts.title: ModelOutputVersion
parts.body: Which version of a model's outputs this task writes, so a result can be matched to the settings that made it.

parts.title: InferenceWork
parts.body: The work itself: the recordings, the model, whether the input is audio or stored embeddings, settings, resources and requested outputs. Its digest is computed, never stored.

parts.title: RecordingRef
parts.body: One recording: a namespace and ID that identify it, where its audio is, its duration, and its stored embeddings if a head will read them.

parts.title: InputArtifact
parts.body: A stored input such as an embeddings file, given by URI and checksum.

parts.title: OutputRequest
parts.body: One requested output (scores, detections or embeddings), the contract it must follow, and how long to keep it.

parts.title: PinnedModel · used by both files
parts.body: The exact model: its model or head card and its files. The work file asks for it and the result repeats it, so a result always names what made it.

parts.title: PinnedFile
parts.body: One model file, by URI, SHA-256 digest and size, so a worker can prove it loaded the right weights.

parts.title: InferenceTaskResult · result.json
parts.body: The top of the result file the worker writes: the task, the digest of the work file it read, the ROBIN release, timings, and one of four outcomes.

parts.title: TaskRefusal
parts.body: The worker would not start, because the work file was misspecified or asked for something its image does not hold.

parts.title: WorkerError
parts.body: An umbrella for any other unexpected failure.

parts.title: InferenceCompleted
parts.body: The task ran: the pinned model, the window geometry, the output artifacts, and an outcome for every recording, covered or failed.

parts.title: InferenceFailure
parts.body: A problem that affected the whole task, such as corrupted model weights.

parts.title: ArtifactRecord
parts.body: One output file: its kind, contract, the recording it covers, where it is, its checksum, size and row count.

parts.title: RecordingCoverage
parts.body: A recording that was covered: how many windows completed and how many rows each output got, or why it had zero windows.

parts.title: RecordingFailed
parts.body: A recording that failed, with the failure. One damaged recording never fails the whole task.

parts.title: FailureReport
parts.body: What went wrong: a code, the stage it happened in, the window if there was one, and detail.
